title: Rectangular plate
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop made up of four straight lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and extends to (0.75, 0.0). The second line runs from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.1549). The third line moves from (0.75, 0.1549) to (0.0, 0.1549), and the fourth line completes the rectangle by returning from (0.0, 0.1549) to the origin. Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector as initially defined. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0082 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional rectangular plate. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The resulting dimensions of the rectangular plate are approximately 0.75 units in length, 0.1549 units in width, and 0.0082 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch for the rectangular plate
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.1549).lineTo(0, 0.1549).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular plate
r = sketch.extrude(0.0082)

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system transformation
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(0, 0, 0.0082))

# Create the sketch for the rectangular plate
sketch = (
    workplane
    .lineTo(0.75, 0)  # line_1
    .lineTo(0.75, 0.1549)  # line_2
    .lineTo(0, 0.1549)  # line_3
    .lineTo(0, 0)  # line_4
    .close()  # Close the loop
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular plate
r = sketch.extrude(0.0082)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.1549) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1549) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular prism
r = r.extrude(0.0082)
